statement: Suppose d1 + d2 = d3 + d4, with di(µ) = 1 for all i. Start with W = W1 ⊥ W2 as above, let t0 be its compact-place data, and choose a total input ϕ for which ξ = ΞW(ϕ; t0) is a nonzero holomorphic top form on a sufficiently deep compact principal quotient X. There are rational orthogonal decompositions W = W3 ⊥ W4 with line signs d3, d4 whose total compact-place positive Lagrangians are arbitrarily close to those at t0. The total active positive Lagrangian is exactly unchanged. For a sufficiently close rational choice t′, the form ξ′ = ΞW(ϕ; t′) is holomorphic on the same quotient X, with the same total finite input, and Z X ξ ∧ ξ′ ̸= 0. (4.18) Both endpoints admit the wedge expansions of Proposition 4.6 on a further common principal cover, and their pairing remains nonzero there.
